from textual.app import App, ComposeResult
from textual.containers import Vertical
from textual.widgets import Header, Footer, Input, Button, Label

class FormApp(App):
    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        yield Header()
        with Vertical():
            yield Label("{{form_title}}")
            yield Input(placeholder="name", id="name")
            yield Input(placeholder="email", id="email")
            yield Button("submit", variant="primary", id="submit")
            yield Label("", id="out")
        yield Footer()

    def on_button_pressed(self, _):
        n = self.query_one("#name", Input).value
        e = self.query_one("#email", Input).value
        self.query_one("#out", Label).update(f"got: {n} <{e}>")

FormApp().run()
